cards.title: Any module, any cast
cards.text: Five modules (Extra, Bounce, Home, Burn, Explode) work on all three casts. Build them on the phone.
cards.why: This is the first test of the module system you said you wanted to try rather than read about.
cards.details:
Pause → Build: a level for each module on each cast, free for now. Chests and level-ups (stage 3) will hand these out instead.

Each module acts at a shared moment: touching an enemy (Burn), hitting a wall (Bounce), the end (Explode). That's why one module works on a bolt, a thrown ball and a dash without a stand-in. A module that has nothing to do on a cast won't be allowed there; all five fit all three so far.

Levels are 0 to 5 here. Numbers show on the build screen.

parts.title: Build screen
parts.text: Pause, then Build. Levels per cast, and what each one does in numbers.

parts.title: All together
parts.text: SMG with Burn, Bounce and Extra; Spawn with Burn, Home and Explode; Dash with Burn, Extra and Explode.

cards.title: The Spawn cast
cards.text: A new stick above the fire stick: throws a ball on a 7 second cooldown.
cards.why: Your answer: charges over time, a cooldown, reads as a spawn. Mark what's off.

parts.title: Throw
parts.text: Drag to aim (a faint path shows where it lands), let go. A quick tap throws at the nearest enemy you can see.

parts.title: The ball
parts.text: Hits by touch, harder the faster it goes. Slows to a stop, sits for 15 seconds or until it's broken. Enemies can't walk through it.

parts.title: Bait
parts.text: Enemies near it go for the ball instead of you, so it buys you room.

cards.title: Modules on the Weapon
cards.text: The same five modules on the Weapon (Bolt), each at level 3, alone.
cards.why: Mark any part that doesn't feel like that module, or comment.

parts.title: Extra
parts.text: +1 bolt a level, fanned out.

parts.title: Bounce
parts.text: Bounces off walls, once a level.

parts.title: Home
parts.text: Curves toward enemies ahead. Turns harder each level.

parts.title: Burn
parts.text: Each hit adds burn. Burning enemies take damage over time; at full build-up they Flare: a big hit and a small fire blast.

parts.title: Explode
parts.text: A blast where the bolt hits or runs out. Walls block it.

cards.title: Modules on the Spawn
cards.text: The same five modules on the Spawn (Ball), each at level 3, alone.
cards.why: Mark any part that doesn't feel like that module, or comment.

parts.title: Extra
parts.text: +1 ball a level, fanned out.

parts.title: Bounce
parts.text: Rebounds off walls at full speed instead of thudding to a stop, once a level.

parts.title: Home
parts.text: Hunts enemies: keeps moving and goes for the nearest one, all its life.

parts.title: Burn
parts.text: Every enemy it hits gets burn.

parts.title: Explode
parts.text: A big blast when it dies or runs out.

cards.title: Modules on the Dash
cards.text: The same five modules on the Dash, each at level 3, alone.
cards.why: Mark any part that doesn't feel like that module, or comment.

parts.title: Extra
parts.text: Dashes again right after, once a level, steered by the move stick (your answer: dashes in a row, not charges).

parts.title: Bounce
parts.text: Rebounds off walls and keeps going, once a level.

parts.title: Home
parts.text: Lunges at an enemy ahead instead of going straight.

parts.title: Burn
parts.text: Everyone you pass gets burn, plus the small hit every dash now does.

parts.title: Explode
parts.text: A blast where the dash ends.
